title: Bill.com Session Credentials
description: Bill.com (BILL) v3 Connect API credentials. The connector POSTs these to /login to obtain an opaque sessionId, which is then sent alongside the developer key on every request. Sessions expire after 35 minutes of inactivity and cannot be refreshed — the connector caches and re-acquires as needed, so no session value is stored here.

username.title: Username
username.description: The BILL user account the integration authenticates as. Use a dedicated integration user rather than a person's login, so access survives staff changes.

organizationId.title: Organization ID
organizationId.description: The BILL organization to operate against. Found in the BILL web app under Settings, or returned by the login response.

devKey.title: Developer Key
devKey.description: The BILL developer key issued for your application. Rate limits are scoped to this key: 3 concurrent requests per organization and 20,000 requests per hour.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Which BILL gateway to target. Defaults to sandbox — a connection must be switched to production deliberately, never by omission.

apiUrl.title: API Base URL (optional)
apiUrl.description: Explicit gateway override. Leave blank to derive from Environment: sandbox is https://gateway.stage.bill.com/connect/v3 and production is https://gateway.prod.bill.com/connect/v3 (note gateway.prod, not gateway). Set this only to point at a mock server or a non-standard gateway.
